name: Dead Letters
source:
Are you human? Of course, otherwise you wouldn’t be down in The Reserve.

Play as Kipper, a rural postman by day and a zealous insurgent by night, in a country colonized by vampires. Over two weeks, you’ll follow Tiamo, a polite Northerner and proclaimed writer whom Kipper suspects of steaming mail for the secret police.

Break into Tiamo’s apartment, read his private correspondence, and wiretap his calls. Document what you find and decide how far you’re willing to invade someone’s privacy.

The only thing Kipper hates more than vampires are mail censors.

[From [url=https://yurinationrise.itch.io/dead-letters]itch.io[/url]]
